visual_action: The video shows a close-up of Kamala Harris smiling slightly. It then cuts to a close-up of Mike Pence, on whose white hair a fly is sitting. The camera slowly zooms in on the fly on Pence's head.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Visibly shown on screen in a close-up shot at the beginning of the video.

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: Visibly shown on screen with a fly on his head, and named in the on-screen text: 'Mike Pence'.

on_screen_text.text: the sound playing through our head when we hear Mike Pence is back on stage to debate this week

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; only music plays.
audio_music: A dramatic, orchestral score ('My Inspiration — Ashwa Ahmad') plays throughout the clip, creating a sense of suspense and mock-seriousness.
editing_pacing: A simple cut from a static shot of Kamala Harris to a static shot of Mike Pence, which then includes a slow zoom-in on Pence's head.
cultural_references: The video references the viral moment from the 2020 Vice Presidential debate when a fly landed and remained on Mike Pence's head for an extended period.
central_claim: The video suggests that the most memorable aspect of Mike Pence as a debater is the comical incident where a fly landed on his head.
intended_effect: To mock Mike Pence by reminding viewers of a past embarrassing moment, thereby diminishing his political stature.
